scope: National Museum of Korea at Yongsan, including the connected east and west wings, open central plaza, mapped curved glass mass, main stairs and the Celadon and Bosingak garden pavilions.
era: Standing museum at Yongsan opened in 2005 and adjoining garden buildings.

review.notes: Exact Qualla original reviewed first. It shows an interior object. The Commons panorama’s original dedication could not be independently verified. The model uses published dimensions and materials, named building and plaza geometry, and original elevation data.
